subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs as the disabled-by-default canonical way to bound wedged deferred turn maintenance?
rationale: The code is concrete and well covered, but adding a new config key and releasing same-session maintenance on timeout is compatibility-sensitive product policy.

options.title: Accept This Opt-In Timeout
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs values as operator-owned bounds for wedged background maintenance.

options.title: Revise Timeout Policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller replacement patch if maintainers want a different default, no config key, or another recovery trigger.

options.title: Use Another Branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if maintainers choose an overlapping PR or replacement branch as the canonical timeout implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept This Opt-In Timeout
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs values as operator-owned bounds for wedged background maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman merged the background turn-maintenance feature and is the clearest routing owner for this config/session-state policy decision.
